[RAOT.1.1] **Every `.dsc` carries an architecture-independent
representation of every expression tree and every RHS action
sequence, and the runtime can interpret it at rule-fire time.**
That is the base execution path, and it is a property of the
artefact rather than of any one encoding: which atoms carry it is
settled by the registry at [RDSC.7.1], not here.
